task: Prompt audit of the kagent Agent CR system messages in src-tauri/src/services/kagent_agents.rs: promql-agent, observability-agent and security-agent each declared capabilities (live metric queries, trace/log analysis, CVE/vulnerability scanning) their CR's tools block does not provide, which invites fabricated answers (D22 lineage). Rewrite the three system messages to state only what their actual toolNames (or absence of a tools block) support, add regression tests pinning that contract, and add the required agent-behavior trace for this src-tauri/** change.

events.summary: In scope: the three systemMessage literal blocks for promql-agent, observability-agent and security-agent in src-tauri/src/services/kagent_agents.rs, plus unit tests in that file's existing tests module. Excluded: rca-agent's systemMessage (already pinned by rca_agent_system_message_forbids_unfounded_hypotheses and not overclaiming), scripts/k8s/security-agent.yaml (separate Helm-managed manifest, not this file's CR), and any change to TOGGLEABLE_AGENTS or the CR's tools/resources blocks. .claude/rules/harness.md and CLAUDE.md changes on this branch are a prior commit (f375a95) from a separate task, not touched here.

Read src-tauri/src/services/kagent_agents.rs before editing and confirmed each claim the task asked to verify: promql-agent's Agent CR (lines 58-76 pre-edit) has no `tools:` key at all; observability-agent's CR (lines 77-95 pre-edit) likewise has no `tools:` key; security-agent's CR declares exactly toolNames [k8s_get_resources, k8s_describe_resource, k8s_get_events] and no others. All three claims held, so all three rewrites were applied.

Replaced promql-agent's systemMessage (was: 'an AI agent for cluster metrics and Prometheus analysis', implying live metric access with zero tools) with text stating it has no tools and cannot query live metrics. Replaced observability-agent's systemMessage (was: 'analyzing OpenTelemetry and trace data', implying it ingests telemetry with zero tools) with text stating it has no tools and works only from pasted data. Replaced security-agent's systemMessage (was: 'a specialized AI agent for ... vulnerability scanning', but its tools are read-only k8s_get_resources/k8s_describe_resource/k8s_get_events with no scanner) with text scoping it to RBAC/PodSecurity/event auditing and explicitly disclaiming CVE scanning. Added 3 new tests: every_toggleable_agent_manifest_parses_as_one_yaml_document (structural single-document check, no YAML crate in Cargo.toml so string/indentation based), promql_and_observability_agents_declare_no_tools_and_say_so, and security_agent_system_message_disclaims_cve_scanning (also pins that its three real toolNames are still present).

cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml kagent_agents: 9 passed, 0 failed (the 6 pre-existing rca-agent/list-agreement tests plus the 3 new tests). Full suite: cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml: 254 passed, 0 failed, 1 ignored (pre-existing real-GPU benchmark, unrelated).
